setup: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo COMMENT 'UrbanFlow Demo3: isolated, disposable governance demonstration. Copies of public data only; dropped after evidence.'

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.station_reference AS SELECT station_id, station_short_name, station_name, latitude, longitude, capacity, CASE WHEN latitude >= 40.75 THEN 'NORTH' ELSE 'SOUTH' END AS dispatch_zone FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow.dim_station_development_sample

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.trips_slice AS SELECT ride_id, rideable_type, started_at, ended_at, start_station_id, member_casual FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow.silver_historical_trips WHERE execution_id = 'urbanflow-hist-202401-full-gh-37140618864-1' ORDER BY ride_id LIMIT 1000
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.zone_access (user_email STRING, dispatch_zone STRING)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.zone_row_filter(zone STRING) RETURNS BOOLEAN COMMENT 'A dispatcher sees only zones mapped to them in zone_access.' RETURN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.zone_access a WHERE a.user_email = current_user() AND (a.dispatch_zone = zone OR a.dispatch_zone = 'ALL'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.coordinate_mask(value DOUBLE) RETURNS DOUBLE COMMENT 'Two decimal places (about 1 km) unless in urbanflow_admins.' RETURN CASE WHEN is_account_group_member('urbanflow_admins') THEN value ELSE ROUND(value, 2) END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.ride_id_mask(value STRING) RETURNS STRING COMMENT 'Stable one-way SHA-256 hash unless in urbanflow_admins.' RETURN CASE WHEN is_account_group_member('urbanflow_admins') THEN value ELSE SHA2(value, 256) END
apply: ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.station_reference SET ROW FILTER dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.zone_row_filter ON (dispatch_zone)
ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.station_reference ALTER COLUMN latitude SET MASK dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.coordinate_mask
ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.station_reference ALTER COLUMN longitude SET MASK dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.coordinate_mask
ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.trips_slice ALTER COLUMN ride_id SET MASK dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.ride_id_mask
rollback: ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.station_reference ALTER COLUMN latitude DROP MASK
ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.station_reference ALTER COLUMN longitude DROP MASK
ALTER TABLE dbr_dev.parvinbadalov_urbanflow_governance_demo.trips_slice ALTER COLUMN ride_id DROP MASK
